chat.title: Chat
banter.grumbling.turn: Another turn, another ache in my back.
Mark it in the Annals: dealt rubbish again.
Your turn. Try not to take all night.
Cursed cards. Cursed table. Cursed wind.
I've seen better hands on a gibbet.
Go on, then. It won't help you.
banter.grumbling.ahead: Don't get used to it. Luck is a whore.
Winning, and still I'm not happy.
The coin's mine for now. The Annals will call it luck.
Fine. A good run. It won't last.
I'll take it, though I don't trust it.
Even a blind crow finds a corpse.
banter.grumbling.behind: Why do I always get a bad hand?
My purse weeps and so do I.
Years in the Company and still this luck.
The cards hate me. Everybody hates me.
I'd be better off selling my boots.
Somebody's cheating. I just can't prove it yet.
banter.grumbling.nudge: Well? What are you waiting for?
Did you fall asleep on your cards?
banter.jovial.nudge: Ha! Is it the cards or the wine slowing you?
Come on, friend, the night's not getting younger!
What are you waiting for? Christmas?
Take your time! ...Or, you know, don't.
banter.sly.nudge: Don't mind us. We'll just wait. Forever.
Thinking so hard. It won't help.
banter.nervous.nudge: Um... is it still your turn?
What are you waiting for? Please say it's nothing.
The silence is worse than the cards.
Are you stuck? Should we worry?
banter.cold.nudge: Time passes. Do not waste it.
banter.jovial.turn: Your turn, friend. Make it a good one!
Ha! Fine company and fine cards tonight.
Plenty of night left and plenty of coin to lose!
Go on, then. I'll wait. I'm in no hurry.
A merry table, this. I'm glad of it.
Whatever comes, we're alive and sitting.
banter.jovial.ahead: Ha ha! The cards love me tonight!
Pour another round! I'm feeling lucky.
Don't worry, I'll leave you your boots.
What a fine day to be a mercenary!
I told you it would go my way!
Cheer up, lads. It's only coin.
banter.jovial.behind: Ha! Lose some, lose more. Still, good company.
Bad luck is only luck that hasn't changed its mind.
The coins will come back. They always do... mostly.
It's only money, friends. I've lost worse.
Never mind. Better cards next hand, I can feel it!
Ha! Take my coin, I'll take your wine.
banter.sly.turn: Oh, I've a lovely little plan.
Take your time. It won't save you.
Something smells like an easy purse.
banter.sly.ahead: Such pretty coins. Come to me.
Do keep playing. You're doing so well, for me.
Your purse is looking thin, friend.
banter.sly.behind: Heh. Let them think they're winning.
A small loss. A very small loss.
The cards owe me. They'll pay.
Laugh now. I'll be laughing last.
I let you win that one. Honest.
Cheaters never prosper. Pity I'm not one. Yet.
banter.nervous.turn: Oh. Is it my turn? Already?
Do you think this is a good hand? Be honest.
I don't like how quiet it's got.
I keep thinking of the Taken. Pass the lamp.
banter.nervous.ahead: Is... is this really happening? I'm winning?
It's a trap. It has to be a trap.
Don't look at my coins. Please.
Luck like this always costs something.
Maybe I should stop while I'm ahead.
Nobody tell the Captain I'm winning.
banter.nervous.behind: I knew it. I knew this would happen.
Oh no. Oh no, no, no.
That's the last of my luck, I swear.
My pay is spoken for. Truly it is.
I should have stayed on watch.
Next hand. Next hand it turns, surely.
banter.cold.turn: I have seen this hand before. It did not end well for you.
Do be quick. The dead have all the time they need.
The night is long. Your purse is not.
banter.cold.ahead: You play like a man who hopes for mercy.
Don't be ashamed. Few last this long against me.
banter.cold.behind: Savour it. It will not be repeated.
Luck is a leash. I have slipped worse.
Enjoy the coin. It is only borrowed.
Fine. I let the cards believe they matter.

rules.title: Tonk rules
rules.goal.title: Goal
rules.goal.items: This game is played by 2 to 5 players.
Win the hand in one of two ways: have the lowest total when a player goes down, or get rid of all your cards. The losers pay the winner.
rules.values.title: Card values
rules.values.items: Ace = 1. Cards 2–10 = the number on the card. Jack, Queen and King = 10 each.
rules.deal.title: The deal
rules.deal.items: Each player gets 5 cards. One card is turned face up to start the discard pile. The other cards form the draw pile. The player to the left of the dealer plays first.

TONK: right after the deal, if your hand total is 15 or less, or 49 or more, you must call it: press the TONK! button to put your cards down (it is pressed for you if you take too long). Then you win immediately and every other player pays you double (2). If two or more players have Tonk, nobody wins and the cards are dealt again. You can only get Tonk right after the deal, never later in the hand.
rules.turn.title: Your turn – choose one option
rules.turn.items: Go down (only at the start of your turn): you show your hand and say its total. Everyone’s totals are compared.
If your total is lower than every other player’s total, you win. Each other player pays you 1.

If any other player has the same total as you or a lower one, you lose. A tie is a loss for you, not a win. You pay 2 to each player whose total is the same as yours or lower. Each player with a higher total pays 1 to the player with the lowest total.

Normal play: take the top card of the draw pile or the top card of the discard pile. Then you may put down spreads (see below) and add cards to spreads that are already on the table. At the end of your turn, discard one card.
rules.spreads.title: Putting cards down
rules.spreads.items: A spread (also called a meld) is a group of cards you put down on the table. There are two kinds of spread: sets and runs.
Set: 3 or 4 cards with the same number or letter (for example 8-8-8).
Run: 3 or more cards of the same suit in number order (for example 4-5-6 of hearts). Ace is only low: A-2-3 is allowed, but Q-K-A is not. You cannot continue from King to Ace.
To put down a spread, select the cards in your hand and press “Spread”. Cards you put down do not count in your hand total.

Adding to a spread (also called laying off): you can add one card to either end of any run on the table, including runs of other players. Select the card, then click the run. You cannot add cards to sets.
rules.emptyHand.title: Winning by emptying your hand
rules.emptyHand.items: If you have no cards left during your turn (after putting down a spread, adding to a spread, or     discarding your last card), you win. Every other player pays you double (2).
House rule: in the original rules (see Credits) emptying your hand pays the normal bet (1). Here it pays double.
rules.words.title: Words you may hear
rules.words.items: Spread or meld: a group of cards put down on the table (a set or a run).
Add to a spread, lay off or hit: put one card from your hand on a run that is already on the table.
Go down, drop or knock: end the hand by showing your cards, hoping to have the lowest total.
Draw pile or stock: the face-down cards you draw from. Discard pile: the face-up cards you throw away.
Caught: you went down but another player had the same total or a lower one, so you pay double.
rules.other.title: Other
rules.other.items: If the draw pile is empty, the discard pile is shuffled to make a new draw pile. The top discard card stays in place.

The coins in the side panel are what each player has left. A plain win pays 1 bet; TONK, getting caught going down or emptying your hand (a house rule) pays 2 bets; the host sets the starting coins and the bet before the game starts. Nobody can pay more than they have. A player who loses their last coin is out of the game: humans keep watching as guests, bots are thrown out.
rules.credits.title: Credits
bot.bomanz.bio: Reasons about the odds very well but forgets what was discarded.
bot.case.bio: Works out the odds very well, then never dares: almost never goes down early.
bot.cordy.bio: Still learning: weak at everything, and slow about it.
bot.croaker.bio: Whines about every hand while quietly counting every discard: observant, and dangerous over a long session.
bot.goblin.bio: Sharp memory and strong card math, but constantly undermines the game with careless, sloppy plays.
bot.hagop.bio: Steady, slightly below average fundamentals with zero emotional reaction: wins and losses never rattle him.
bot.one-eye.bio: Average skills, but wins and losses throw the mood completely: brilliant when confident, reckless when behind.
bot.otto.bio: An above average player: good, but beatable.
bot.silent.bio: Plays a perfect hand and ignores everybody else: goes down by rule of thumb and never reads the table.
bot.the-lady.bio: Near-flawless memory, math and table awareness: reads every move at lightning speed and rarely makes a mistake.
bot.the-lieutenant.bio: Only here for the company: chats with everybody and notices who does what, but has no head for the odds, forgets the discards and guesses on a whim.
bot.willow-swan.bio: Sharp, but bets everything on thin edges: goes down early whenever the odds look even slightly good.
